Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv:2609.06905v1 Appendix B.3 B19/B20/B22/B23/B24 and Lemma B.3. ASTIS derives the sharp bound from the same actual original-input operators; the genuine Test proves modified-energy equivalence.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X~μ and Z~N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. These are probability laws. Put mY=comap(snd), H_P=L² classes measurable with respect to mY, P=i∘E[·|Y] and the canonical M:u↦u∘snd. Then H_P=ran(P), P is identity on H_P, and there exists an onto linear isometry e:L²(ν;ℝ)≃H_P with i e=M. There is a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized law is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)); Λ.IsCondKernel S and both Λ marginals equal ν. The same joint reflection F(x,y)=(x,2x−y) gives the involutive selfadjoint isometry U, with Uf=f∘F J-almost everywhere for every f. There is a bounded selfadjoint T on the full real L²(ν), with ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere for each u, and preserved integral. On H_P put A=PUP restricted via i and orthogonal projection, and B=(I_J−P)UPi:H_P→L²(J). Then A=eTe⁻¹ is selfadjoint and contractive, PB=0. There is a bounded positive operator Γ on the real scalar-valued L² space with Γ²=I−T². For the SAME transported Γ_P=eΓe⁻¹, positivity holds and Γ_P²=I_H_P−A²=B*B. There is q∈L²(ν;ℝ) equal to one ν-almost everywhere, with Tq=q and ⟨q,u⟩=∫u dν for every u. Set q_P=e q and H_P^0=ker⟨q_P,·⟩, with its inherited Hilbert structure. Membership is exactly zero ν-mean after e⁻¹. The SAME Γ_P annihilates q_P. Put γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη)>0. There exists Γ_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 equal under inclusion to the restriction of Γ_P, positive with Γ_0−γ I positive. Γ_0 is a unit in the algebra of bounded real operators. There exists a bounded real Inv on this SAME centered space with Inv Γ_0=Γ_0 Inv=I and ‖Inv‖≤1/γ. All probability, normalization, range, root, centering, spectral-gap, unit and inverse facts are internally derived from the original inputs; none is an additional public premise. αη=1 and rank-zero E remain legal. No inverse on full H_P is asserted. Define the actual closed conditional-mean-zero space H_perp=ker P in L²(J;ℝ), with its inherited complete Hilbert structure; this is not merely the globally zero-mean joint space. There exists B_0:H_P^0→H_perp whose inclusion equals B i_0. There exists V_0:H_P^0→H_perp with V_0=B_0 Inv, B_0=V_0 Γ_0, V_0* V_0=I and ‖V_0 f‖=‖f‖ for every f∈H_P^0. All these objects and identities are conclusions from the same original inputs. There exists the canonical bounded residual map R:L²(J;ℝ)→H_perp with i_perp Rg=g−Pg for every joint g. The SAME ambient adjoint satisfies B* g=i_0 B_0* Rg for every joint g; the printed intrinsic block adjoint is recovered on H_perp. For every actual joint f∈L²(J;ℝ) with ∫f dJ=0, there exists f_P∈H_P^0 whose inclusion is E[f|Y]. Put f_perp=Rf and f_V=V_0* f_perp∈the SAME H_P^0. Then B* i_perp f_perp=i_0 Γ_0 f_V=Γ_P i_0 f_V, ‖f‖²=‖f_P‖²+‖f_perp‖² and ‖f_V‖≤‖f_perp‖. The preceding independently reviewed ambient-adjoint Test derives f=i i_0 f_P+i_perp f_perp, B* f=Γ_P i_0 f_V and ‖f_V‖²≤‖f‖²−‖f_P‖². The global zero-mean condition is a quantified input restriction to this concluded implication, not an extra assumption on the potential or an operator certificate. The SAME root commutes with T and its transport commutes with A. The SAME Inv on H_P^0 is selfadjoint. There exists an internally constructed A_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 whose inclusion equals A after inclusion; it is selfadjoint,commutes with Γ_0,satisfies A_0²+Γ_0²=I,and commutes with the SAME Inv. The SAME coefficient K=A_0 Inv is selfadjoint and I+K²=Inv². Define C(u,v)=(‖u‖²−‖v‖²)/2−⟨Ku,v⟩ on the SAME centered Hilbert space H_P^0. For every u,v in H_P^0, |C(u,v)|≤(‖u‖²+‖v‖²)/(2γ). All coefficient identities, domains and bounds are conclusions from the original potential and step inputs. The genuine original-input Test then proves, for every real 0<omegaWeight≤γ and L=‖f‖²+omegaWeight C(f_P,f_V), that ‖f‖²/2≤L≤3‖f‖²/2 and |L−‖f‖²|≤omegaWeight ‖f‖²/(2γ)≤‖f‖²/2. These are the first-corrector bound and Lemma B.3 energy equivalence. {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let Λ := J.map (fun p : E × E => (p.2,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2))
    let F := fun p : E × E => (p.1,(2 : ℝ) • p.1-p.2)
    let mY := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E)
    letI : MeasurableSpace (E × E) := Prod.instMeasurableSpace
    letI : Fact (mY ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (E × E))) :=
      ⟨measurable_snd.comap_le⟩
    let HP := lpMeas ℝ ℝ mY 2 J
    let P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
      HP.subtypeL ∘L condExpL2 ℝ ℝ (μ := J) measurable_snd.comap_le
    let hp : MeasurePreserving (Prod.snd : E × E → E) J ν := ⟨measurable_snd,rfl⟩
    let M : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢ ℝ Prod.snd hp

    HP = P.toLinearMap.range ∧
    (∀ f : HP, P (f : Lp ℝ 2 J) = f) ∧
    ∃ S : Kernel E E, IsMarkovKernel S ∧
      (∀ y, S y = (volume : Measure E).tilted

      Λ.IsCondKernel S ∧ Λ.fst = ν ∧ Λ.snd = ν ∧
      ∃ e : Lp ℝ 2 ν ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] HP,
        (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, (e u : Lp ℝ 2 J) = M u) ∧
        ∃ U : Lp ℝ 2 J →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J,

          Function.Involutive U ∧ IsSelfAdjoint U.toContinuousLinearMap ∧
          ∃ T : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
            IsSelfAdjoint T ∧
            (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              ‖T u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ ∧

              (∫ y, T u y ∂ν) = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
            let A : HP →L[ℝ] HP :=
              HP.orthogonalProjectionOnto ∘L U.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L HP.subtypeL
            let B : HP →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
              (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J)-P)*U.toContinuousLinearMap*P) ∘L HP.subtypeL
            A = e.conjStarAlgEquiv T ∧ IsSelfAdjoint A ∧
            (∀ f : HP, ‖A f‖ ≤ ‖f‖) ∧
            (∀ f : HP, P (B f) = 0) ∧
            ∃ Γ : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν,
              Γ.IsPositive ∧ Γ*Γ=(1 : Lp ℝ 2 ν →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 ν)-T*T ∧

              let ΓP : HP →L[ℝ] HP := e.conjStarAlgEquiv Γ
              ΓP.IsPositive ∧ ΓP*ΓP=(1 : HP →L[ℝ] HP)-A*A ∧
              Commute ΓP A ∧
              B.adjoint ∘L B = ΓP*ΓP ∧
              ∃ q : Lp ℝ 2 ν,
                (q : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[ν] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧ T q = q ∧
                (∀ u : Lp ℝ 2 ν, inner ℝ q u = ∫ y, u y ∂ν) ∧
                let qP : HP := e q
                let HP0 := (innerSL ℝ qP).ker
                letI : NormedAddCommGroup HP0 := HP0.normedAddCommGroup
                letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ HP0 := HP0.innerProductSpace
                letI : CompleteSpace HP0 := (innerSL ℝ qP).isClosed_ker.completeSpace_coe
                let γ : ℝ := 2*Real.sqrt ((α : ℝ)*η)/(1+(α : ℝ)*η)
                (∀ f : HP, f ∈ HP0 ↔ (∫ y, (e.symm f) y ∂ν) = 0) ∧
                ΓP qP = 0 ∧ 0 < γ ∧

                  ΓP0.IsPositive ∧ (ΓP0-γ • (1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0)).IsPositive ∧
                  IsUnit ΓP0 ∧
                  ∃ Inv : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0,
                    Inv*ΓP0=(1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧
                    ΓP0*Inv=(1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧ ‖Inv‖ ≤ 1/γ ∧
                    IsSelfAdjoint Inv ∧
                    ∃ A0 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0,
                      (∀ u : HP0, (A0 u : HP)=A (u : HP)) ∧
                      IsSelfAdjoint A0 ∧ Commute A0 ΓP0 ∧
                      A0*A0+ΓP0*ΓP0=(1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧
                      Commute A0 Inv ∧
                      IsSelfAdjoint (A0*Inv) ∧
                      (1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0)+(A0*Inv)*(A0*Inv)=Inv*Inv ∧
                    let C : HP0 → HP0 → ℝ := fun u v =>
                      (1/2 : ℝ)*(‖u‖^2-‖v‖^2)-inner ℝ ((A0*Inv) u) v
                    (∀ u v : HP0, |C u v| ≤ (‖u‖^2+‖v‖^2)/(2*γ)) ∧
                    let Hperp := P.ker
                    letI : NormedAddCommGroup Hperp := Hperp.normedAddCommGroup
                    letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ Hperp := Hperp.innerProductSpace
                    letI : CompleteSpace Hperp := P.isClosed_ker.completeSpace_coe
                    ∃ B0 : HP0 →L[ℝ] Hperp,
                      (∀ f : HP0, (B0 f : Lp ℝ 2 J) = B (f : HP)) ∧
                      ∃ V0 : HP0 →L[ℝ] Hperp,
                        V0 = B0 ∘L Inv ∧ B0 = V0 ∘L ΓP0 ∧
                        V0.adjoint ∘L V0 = (1 : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0) ∧
                        (∀ f : HP0, ‖V0 f‖ = ‖f‖) ∧
                        ∃ R : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Hperp,
                          (∀ g : Lp ℝ 2 J, (R g : Lp ℝ 2 J)=g-P g) ∧
                          (∀ g : Lp ℝ 2 J,
                            B.adjoint g=HP0.subtypeL (B0.adjoint (R g))) ∧
                          (∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 J, (∫ z, f z ∂J)=0 →
                            ∃ fP : HP0,
                              HP0.subtypeL fP=condExpL2 ℝ ℝ (μ:=J) measurable_snd.comap_le f ∧
                              let fperp : Hperp := R f
                              let fV : HP0 := V0.adjoint fperp
                              B.adjoint (fperp : Lp ℝ 2 J)=HP0.subtypeL (ΓP0 fV) ∧
                              HP0.subtypeL (ΓP0 fV)=ΓP (HP0.subtypeL fV) ∧
                              ‖f‖^2=‖fP‖^2+‖fperp‖^2 ∧ ‖fV‖≤‖fperp‖ ∧
                              ‖fP‖^2+‖fV‖^2≤‖f‖^2 ∧
                              |C fP fV|≤‖f‖^2/(2*γ))
